name: Matrix Robotics MATRIX-3
summary: A third-generation bipedal humanoid launched in January 2026 with 27-DOF cable-driven hands, tactile fingertips and a fabric skin, offered through an early-access programme ahead of pilot deployments.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU sales route found; Matrix Robotics offers only an Early Access Program for select industry partners and an email contact.

specs.label: DOF per hand
specs.quote: 27-DoF Dexterous Hand: Equipped with a newly designed 27-degree-of-freedom (DoF) hand

specs.label: Fingertip tactile threshold
specs.quote: The fingertips integrate a high-sensitivity tactile sensor array capable of detecting pressure as low as 0.1N.

specs.label: Actuators
specs.quote: Its power core consists of integrated linear actuators that combine high power density with low-noise operation

specs.label: Availability
specs.value: early access; pilots expected from mid-2026
specs.quote: Matrix Robotics has opened an Early Access Program for MATRIX-3 to select industry partners, with initial pilot deployments expected to begin in mid-2026.

notes: Walking is driven by a general motion-control model trained on human motion-capture data ('Natural Humanoid Gait').
Body is covered in a 3D-woven fabric skin with distributed impact sensing.
No height, weight, payload or runtime figures are published.

evidence.task: General tasks across commercial services, manufacturing, logistics, medical assistance and homes
evidence.note: Launch announcement; no pilot site named. No construction use reported.
